title: Kurt Vonnegut on the Shapes of Stories
summary: A short lecture in which Kurt Vonnegut graphs the simple shapes of stories, such as Man in Hole and Boy Gets Girl. He sketches how fortune rises and falls over a narrative.
why: HN cites it as a charming, funny way to see story structure and a source for the idea that plots have shapes.

quote.text: Vonnegut is really special. I always like coming back to his Shape of Stories talks
